Anthropic — prompt caching activates only via explicit cache_control breakpoints; usage fields cache_creation_input_tokens / cache_read_input_tokens; input_tokens = tokens after the last breakpoint (total = read + creation + input); 5-min TTL default, 1h at 2x (verified 2026-09-12)
Anthropic — Messages API reference: StopReason union is "end_turn" or "max_tokens" or "stop_sequence" or others; usage carries input_tokens, output_tokens and detail fields (verified 2026-09-12)

Anthropic — OpenAI SDK compatibility at base https://api.anthropic.com/v1/: prompt caching 'not supported' in compat mode, usage prompt/completion_tokens fully supported but *_details fields 'always empty' (verified 2026-09-12)

OpenAI — 'Prompt caching is enabled by default for supported OpenAI models', minimum 1,024 tokens for GPT-5.6+; cached tokens sit inside input_tokens (guide computes ordinaryInputTokens = inputTokens - cachedTokens - cacheWriteTokens); reads 0.1x, writes 1.25x on GPT-5.6+; 30-min TTL (verified 2026-09-12)

Vercel — limits: CLI source uploads capped at 100 MB (Hobby) / 1 GB (Pro) and 15,000 files; 'no upper limit for output files created during a build'; build cache 1 GB; Fast Data Transfer 100 GB Hobby / 1 TB Pro (verified 2026-09-12)
Vercel — plans: Hobby includes 100 GB Fast Data Transfer; Hobby plans are paused when included usage is exceeded (verified 2026-09-12)

Vercel — pricing: Hobby '100 GB / month included'; Pro '1TB / month included; then starting at $0.15 per GB'; FAQ: 'Requests to static assets incur the same Fast Data Transfer usage if the response is cached or uncached'; Blob card: $0.023/GB storage, 1 GB + 10 GB transfer free on Hobby (verified 2026-09-12)
Vercel — regional on-demand pricing: Fast Data Transfer $0.15–$0.35 per GB; Blob storage $0.023–$0.041 per GB-month; Blob data transfer $0.05–$0.117 per GB (verified 2026-09-12)
Vercel — fair use guidelines: Fast Data Transfer 'Up to 100 GB' Hobby / 'Up to 1 TB' Pro (verified 2026-09-12)

Vercel Blob — public stores readable by 'anyone with the URL' on *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com; 'Blob Data Transfer fees apply only to downloads'; writes require an authenticated Vercel account (verified 2026-09-12)

MDN — video codecs: H.264/VP9 supported in all Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, Safari (Firefox H.264 depends on OS codecs); AV1 in all browsers but Safari only with a hardware decoder (Safari 17+, M3 Macs / iPhone 15 Pro+); containers MP4/WebM (verified 2026-09-12)
caniuse — AV1 95.02% global support; Safari 17+ partial (hardware-dependent) (verified 2026-09-12)

caniuse — H.264/MP4 97.26% global support; iOS Safari since 3.2 (verified 2026-09-12)

FFmpeg wiki — x264 encoding: CRF 0–51 ('0 is lossless'), sane range 17–28; slower presets give better compression; -pix_fmt yuv420p needed for QuickTime/4:2:0-only players; tune=animation for cartoon-like content (verified 2026-09-12)
FFmpeg wiki — VP9 constant quality via -crf with -b:v 0, CRF 0–63 (31 recommended for 1080p); -row-mt 1 for threading; two-pass recommended for rate-targeted encodes (verified 2026-09-12)

HTML Media spec — seeking: precise currentTime seeks 'set the current playback position to the new playback position' and decode 'enough data to play back that position'; seeks clamp to the nearest seekable position; waiting fires when readyState drops below HAVE_FUTURE_DATA; fastSeek() is the keyframe-snapping variant (verified 2026-09-12)

MDN — currentTime: 'Changing the value of currentTime seeks the media to the new time'; value is a double in seconds and 'an approximation of the current playback position' with browser-dependent update frequency (verified 2026-09-12)
MDN — seeked event fires when the seek completes and seeking flips to false (verified 2026-09-12)
MDN — requestAnimationFrame 'calls are paused in most browsers when running in background tabs or hidden iframes' (verified 2026-09-12)

MDN — autoplay guide: muted media autoplays; Firefox default media.autoplay.allow-muted; example marks videos with 'controls autoplay playsinline muted', noting playsinline 'is required for autoplay in Safari'; play() rejects with NotAllowedError when blocked (verified 2026-09-12)
Chrome — autoplay policy: 'Muted autoplay is always allowed'; sound requires user gesture or high Media Engagement Index (verified 2026-09-12)

FlappyBench — published writeup: per-model one-shot HTML game artifacts, USD cost per model ($0.0008 DeepSeek-V4-Pro to ~$0.2539 Opus 5), no wall-clock time, 1–5 author scores plus automated 600-frame smoke test and quality-per-$ ranking (verified 2026-09-12)

Goldie Bench — game task: live playable one-shot HTML per model ('Click any tile to run that model's actual one-shot HTML'), no cost/time shown, author-scored 3 axes 0–10 plus pixel-diff smoke tests (verified 2026-09-12)

Design Arena — crowdsourced Elo/win-rate leaderboard; per-model cost and generation time appear only as scatter charts ('Preference vs Price', 'Preference vs Speed'); leaderboard is JS-rendered, not crawlable (verified 2026-09-12)
